name: config3
description: Round 3 of 3 - the last twelve fibre ports, so five pairs: 20-24 paired with 25-29, the VMC on ports 30 and 31, and the copper legs 32<->30 and 33<->31

health_monitor.comment: the VMC's health monitor, port 30 out to the 1G copper link
the VMC's health monitor, port 31 out to the 100M copper link

health_monitor_flags_note: flags 0x9 (ENABLE|RESERVED), which is what every record in the captured configuration carries, taps included. 0xD - the extra PRIORITY bit - appears only on VL 4488 in the reference blob, so it belongs to that VL and not to taps in general.

dtn_health_monitor.comment: the DTN's own, out of the internal management port; VL 38 is also written into the end-system block
